     1	
     2	# MD4C Change Log
     3	
     4	
     5	## Next Version (Work in Progress)
     6	
     7	New Features:
     8	
     9	  * Add extension recognizing GFM-like admonitions, as e.g.
    10	
    11	    ```
    12	    > [!IMPORTANT]
    13	    > Text of an important note.
    14	    ```
    15	
    16	    The flag `MD_FLAG_ADMONITIONS` enables this extension.
    17	
    18	  * Add extension recognizing superscripts and subscripts with `^superscript^`
    19	    and `~subscript~` syntax respectively. Flags `MD_FLAG_SUPERSCRIPTS` and
    20	    `MD_FLAG_SUBSCRIPTS` enable these extensions.
    21	
    22	    Note that if both `MD_FLAG_SUBSCRIPTS` and `MD_FLAG_STRIKETHROUGH` are
    23	    enabled, strike-through requires double tildes: `~~strike-through~~`.
    24	
    25	    Contributed by [Gregory Moskaliuk](https://github.com/hryhoriiK97).
    26	
    27	  * Add extension recognizing spoilers with `||hidden text||` syntax. This
    28	    follows syntax used by Telegram and Discord Markdown implementations.
    29	    It needs to be explicitly enabled with `MD_FLAG_SPOILERS`. (Note though that
    30	    the HTML renderer outputs them verbatim in a custom `<x-spoiler>` tag.)
    31	
    32	    Contributed by [Gregory Moskaliuk](https://github.com/hryhoriiK97).
    33	
    34	Changes:
    35	
    36	  * Permissive autolinks (`MD_FLAG_PERMISSIVExxxAUTOLINKS` flags) have been
    37	    improved and some links with non-alphanumeric characters are now recognized.
    38	
    39	    However please note this will always be a subject of painful search for
    40	    reasonable trade-off between recognizing more obscure URLs versus opening
    41	    gates to potential false positives.
    42	
    43	    We generally recommend to use standard autolinks as defined by
    44	    [CommonMark specification](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#autolinks)
    45	    (i.e. enclosed between `<` and `>`), especially for links containing more
    46	    obscure combinations of non-alphanumeric characters.
    47	
    48	
    49	## Version 0.5.3
    50	
    51	Changes:
    52	
    53	  * Avoid repeated prefix `language-` in code block language specification if
    54	    the input already explicitly includes the prefix.
    55	
    56	    Contributed by [Zach Newton](https://github.com/znewt99).
    57	
    58	  * Permissive autolink extensions (`MD_FLAG_PERMISSIVExxxAUTOLINKS`) are now
    59	    tiny bit more permissive, allowing `+` and `-` characters to be anywhere
    60	    in the path portion of the URL. This also improves compatibility with GFM.
    61	
    62	  * Make Unicode-specific code compliant to Unicode 18.0.
    63	
    64	Fixes:
    65	
    66	 * [#236](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/236):
    67	   Fix quadratic time behavior caused by one-by-one walking over block lines
    68	   instead of calling `md_lookup_line()`.
    69	
    70	 * [#238](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/238):
    71	   Fix quadratic time and output size behavior caused by malicious misuse of
    72	   link reference definitions.
    73	
    74	 * [#242](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/242):
    75	   The strike-through extension (with flag `MD_FLAG_STRIKETHROUGH`) now follows
    76	   same logic as other emphasis spans in respect to punctuation character and
    77	   word boundaries.
    78	
    79	 * [#248](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/248):
    80	   Fix handling tab when removing trailing whitespace, especially in connection
    81	   with ATX headers.
    82	
    83	 * [#266](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/266):
    84	   We now correctly abort the parser when a callback returns non-zero.
    85	   (Previously it worked correctly only for negative values, values greater
    86	   than zero were causing strange and inconsistent behavior.)
    87	
    88	 * [#271](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/271):
